grammar_daily_topic: Present Simple - kundalik odatlar va faktlar uchun (I work, She studies)
Present Continuous - hozir davom etayotgan harakatlar uchun (I am working, She is studying)
Present Perfect - hozirgi paytga bog'liq harakatlar uchun (I have finished, She has arrived)
Past Simple - tugallangan o'tmish harakatlari uchun (I worked, She studied)
Past Continuous - o'tmishdagi davom etayotgan harakatlar (I was working, She was studying)
Past Perfect - o'tmishdagi harakatlar tartibini ko'rsatish uchun (I had finished before she arrived)
Will - bashorat, qaror va va'dalar uchun (I will help you, It will rain)
Going to - rejalar va niyatlar uchun (I am going to study, She is going to travel)
Present Continuous (kelajak) - rejalashtirilgan kelajak harakatlari (I am meeting him tomorrow)
Can va Could - qobiliyat, imkoniyat va ruxsat ifodalash (I can swim, Could you help me?)
Must va Have to - majburiyat va zaruriyat ifodalash (You must stop, I have to go)
Should - maslahat berish uchun (You should eat more vegetables)
Might va May - ehtimollik ifodalash (It might rain, She may be late)
First Conditional - kelajakdagi haqiqiy vaziyatlar (If it rains, I will stay home)
Second Conditional - hozirgi yoki kelajakdagi xayoliy vaziyatlar (If I had money, I would travel)
Comparatives va Superlatives - qiyoslash va eng yuqori daraja (bigger, the biggest; more beautiful, the most beautiful)
Yes/No questions va Wh-questions - umumiy va maxsus so'roq gaplar (Do you like it? Where do you live?)
Tag questions - qisqa so'roq gaplar (It's nice, isn't it? You didn't go, did you?)
Passive Voice - hozirgi va o'tmish zamonlarda asosiy qurilmalar (The book is written, The house was built)
Reported Speech - say va tell bilan darak gaplar (She said that she was tired, He told me he would come)
Reported Speech - so'roq gaplar o'zlashtirma nutqda (She asked where I lived, He asked if I was ready)
Quantifiers - some, any, much, many, a lot of, few, little va boshqalar (There is some water, I don't have any books)
Relative Clauses - who, which, that bilan aniqlovchi va qo'shimcha nisbiy gaplar (The man who called, The book which I read)
Adverbs va Adverbial Phrases - tarz, chastota, vaqt va joy ravishlar (quickly, always, yesterday, here)
Third Conditional (o'tmishdagi xayoliy vaziyatlar)
Adverbs and adverbial phrases (tarz, chastota, vaqt, joy ifodalari)

grammar_archive.topic: Present Simple - kundalik odatlar va faktlar uchun (I work, She studies)

parts.2: 🇬🇧 Present Simple: Darak gaplar (2/5-qism) 📌 Present Simple zamoni doimiy odatlar, takrorlanib turadigan harakatlar va umumiy faktlarni ifodalash uchun xizmat qiladi. 📝 Darak gap formulasi: • I / You / We / They + V1 (fe'lning bosh shakli) • He / She / It + V1 + (-s / -es) 🗣️ Misollar: • I work in a big company. — Men katta kompaniyada ishlayman. • She studies IT at university. — U universitetda IT sohasini o'rganadi. • We live in Tashkent. — Biz Toshkentda yashaymiz. • The sun rises in the east. — Quyosh sharqdan chiqadi. ❗ Muhim eslatma: Ega he, she, it (uchinchi shaxs birlik) bo'lganda, fe'l oxiriga albatta -s yoki -es qo'shimchasi qo'shilishini unutmang! ❌ He work every day. ✅ He works every day.
parts.3: 📌 Present Simple: Inkor gaplar (3/5) 💡 Present Simple zamonida inkor (inkor etuvchi) gap hosil qilish uchun don't (do not) va doesn't (does not) yordamchi fe'llaridan foydalanamiz. 🔤 Inkor gap formulasi: • I / You / We / They + don't + V1 (asosiy fe'l) • He / She / It + doesn't + V1 (asosiy fe'l) 📝 Misollar: • I don't work on Sundays. (Men yakshanba kunlari ishlamayman.) • She doesn't study French at school. (U maktabda fransuz tilini o'rganmaydi.) • We don't like cold weather. (Bizga sovuq ob-havo yoqmaydi.) • He doesn't watch TV in the morning. (U ertalab televizor ko'rmaydi.) ❗ Keng tarqalgan xato: Inkor gapda doesn't ishlatilganda, asosiy fe'l oxiridagi -s yoki -es qo'shimchasi tushib qoladi. Fe'l har doim lug'at shaklida yoziladi. ❌ She doesn't studies biology. ✅ She doesn't study biology.
parts.4: 📌 Present Simple: So'roq gaplar tuzilishi (4/5-qism) ❓ Present Simple zamonida so'roq gaplar tuzish uchun Do va Does yordamchi fe'llaridan foydalanamiz. 📖 So'roq gap formulalari: 🔹 Umumiy so'roq (Yes/No): Do / Does + ega + asosiy fe'l + ...? 🔹 Maxsus so'roq (Wh- questions): Wh-so'z + Do / Does + ega + asosiy fe'l + ...? 💡 Eslatma: He, She, It olmoshlari uchun Does, qolgan barcha shaxslar (I, You, We, They) uchun Do ishlatiladi. 🗣️ Misollar: • Do you work every day? (Siz har kuni ishlaysizmi?) • Does she study at university? (U universitetda o'qiydimi?) • Where do you live? (Siz qayerda yashaysiz?) • What time does he start work? (U ishni soat nechada boshlaydi?) ❗ Muhim qoida: So'roq gapda Does kelganda, asosiy fe'lga -s / -es qo'shimchasi qo'shilmaydi. Masalan: Does she studies? emas, Does she study? deb aytiladi.
parts.5: 📌 Present Simple: Amaliyot va yakuniy test (5/5-qism) 💡 Keng tarqalgan xatolar: Ushbu zamonni ishlatishda ko'pincha ikkita xatoga yo'l qo'yiladi: 1. He, she, it olmoshlaridan keyin fe'lga -s yoki -es qo'shishni unutish. Masalan, She study emas, She studies bo'lishi kerak. 2. Inkor va so'roq gaplarda does / doesn't bo'lsa ham, fe'lga yana -s qo'shish. Masalan, He doesn't works emas, He doesn't work to'g'ri bo'ladi. 📝 Bo'sh joylarni to'ldiring: 1. My brother ___ (play) football every Sunday. 2. She ___ (not / like) drinking cold coffee. 3. ___ you ___ (live) in Tashkent? 4. The sun ___ (rise) in the east. ✅ Javoblar: 1. plays — ega uchinchi shaxs birlikda (My brother = he) bo'lgani uchun fe'lga -s qo'shiladi. 2. doesn't like — she uchun inkor shaklida doesn't ishlatiladi hamda asosiy fe'ldan -s tushib qoladi. 3. Do / live — you olmoshi so'roq gapda Do yordamchi fe'li bilan qo'llanadi. 4. rises — umumiy fakt bo'lib, ega (The sun = it) birlikda bo'lgani uchun fe'lga -s qo'shiladi.

parts.1: ⏳ Third Conditional: O'tmishdagi xayoliy vaziyatlar (1/5) 📌 Third Conditional grammatikasi o'tmishda sodir bo'lgan voqea-hodisalarning aksi haqida gapirish uchun ishlatiladi. Biz ushbu qoida orqali o'tmishda o'zgarishi endi imkonsiz bo'lgan vaziyatlarni, afsuslar va pushaymonliklarni ifodalaymiz. Ya'ni, hayotda voqea allaqachon boshqacha yakunlangan, lekin biz "agar o'shanda boshqacha bo'lganida, natija ham boshqacha bo'lardi" deb xayol qilamiz. Qisqacha aytganda, bu — amalga oshmay qolgan o'tmishdagi imkoniyatlar haqidagi gaplardir. 📝 Oddiy misollar: 🔹 If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam. (Agar qattiqroq o'qiganimda, imtihondan o'tgan bo'lardim. Aslida: yaxshi o'qimadim va yiqildim.) 🔹 If they had taken a taxi, they would have arrived on time. (Agar ular taksi ushlaganlarida, o'z vaqtida yetib kelishgan bo'lardi. Aslida: taksiga o'tirishmadi va kechikishdi.) 💡 Ushbu mavzuning keyingi qismlarida biz Third Conditional qoidasining darak, inkor va so'roq gap tuzilishlarini formula hamda yangi misollar bilan bosqichma-bosqich o'rganamiz. Bizni kuzatishda davom eting!
parts.2: 📌 Third Conditional: Darak gap shakli (2/5-qism) Third Conditional orqali biz o'tmishda yuz bermagan xayoliy vaziyatlar va ularning amalga oshmagan natijalari haqida gapiramiz. Bugun ushbu grammatik qoidaning darak gap (affirmative) tuzilishini ko'rib chiqamiz. 📖 Darak gap formulasi: If + Subject + had + V3, Subject + would have + V3 (Bu yerda V3 — fe'lning o'tgan zamon sifatdoshi shakli, ya'ni Past Participle). 🗣️ Misollar: • If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam. (Agar men ko'proq o'qiganimda, imtihondan o me'yorida o'tgan bo'lardim.) • If she had woken up earlier, she would have caught the train. (Agar u vaqtliroq uyg'onganda, poyezdga ulgurgan bo'lardi.) • If we had taken a taxi, we would have arrived on time. (Agar biz taksi tutganimizda, manzilingizga o'z vaqtida yetib kelgan bo'lardik.) • If they had invited me, I would have gone to the party. (Agar ular meni taklif qilishganda, men bazmga borgan bo'lardim.) 💡 Muhim eslatma: O'zbek tiliga tarjima qilganda har ikkala qism ham "-ganda ... bo'lardi" shaklida ma'no beradi. Ogizaki nutqda had va would so'zlari ko'pincha 'd ko'rinishida qisqartiriladi. ❗ Tez-tez uchraydigan xato: Eshitilishi o'xshash bo'lsa ham, If qismida hech qachon would have ishlatilmaydi. Would have birikmasi faqat asosiy (natija) qismida keladi. ❌ Noto'g'ri: If I would have known, I would have helped. ✅ To'g'ri: If I had known, I would have helped.
parts.3: 📌 Grammar Time: Third Conditional (3/5-qism) – Inkor gaplar 💡 Inkor gap formulasi: If + Subject + hadn't + V3, Subject + wouldn't have + V3 (Vaziyatga qarab inkor inkori hadn't yoki wouldn't have orqali hosil qilinadi). 📖 Misollar: 1. If I hadn't missed the bus, I wouldn't have been late. (Agar avtobusni o'tkazib yubormaganimda, kechikmagan bo'lardim.) 2. If she had studied harder, she wouldn't have failed the exam. (Agar u yaxshiroq o'qiganda, imtihondan yiqilmagan bo'lardi.) 3. If we hadn't spent all our money, we could have bought a new car. (Agar barcha pulimizni sarflamaganimizda, yangi mashina sotib ololgan bo'lardik.) 4. If they hadn't helped us, we wouldn't have finished the project on time. (Agar ular bizga yordam bermaganida, loyihani o'z vaqtida tugatmagan bo me'mor bo'lardik.) ❗ Tez-tez uchraydigan xato: Ko'pchilik if-qismida ham wouldn't have ishlatish xatosini qiladi. Yodda tuting, If bor qismda har doim hadn't ishlatiladi. ❌ If I wouldn't have missed the bus... ✅ If I hadn't missed the bus...
parts.4: 📌 Third Conditional: So'roq gaplar (4/5-qism) 💡 Third Conditionalda so'roq gaplar o'tmishda sodir bo'lmagan voqealar va ularning xayoliy natijalari haqida so'rash uchun ishlatiladi. 📖 1. Umumiy (Yes/No) so'roq gaplar formulasi: Would + ega + have + V3 + if + ega + had + V3? (yoki: If + ega + had + V3, would + ega + have + V3?) 🔤 2. Maxsus (Wh-) so'roq gaplar formulasi: Wh-so'z + would + ega + have + V3 + if + ega + had + V3? 🗣️ Misollarni ko'rib chiqamiz: 1. Would you have passed the exam if you had studied harder? (Agar ko'proq tayyorlanganingda, imtihondan o'tgan bo'larmiding?) 2. If they had left earlier, would they have caught the train? (Agar ular barvaqtroq yo'lga chiqishganda, poyezdga yetib olgan bo'lisharmidi?) 3. What would you have done if you had missed the last bus? (Agar oxirgi avtobusga kechikkaningda, nima qilgan bo'lar eding?) 4. Where would she have gone if she had won the competition? (Agar u musobaqada g'olib chiqqanida, qayerga borgan bo'lar edi?) ❗ Muhim eslatma: So'roq shaklida ham if qismida hech qachon would ishlatilmaydi. Would yordamchi fe'li faqat asosiy natija qismida ega oldiga o'tadi.

grammar_archive.topic: Adverbs and adverbial phrases (tarz, chastota, vaqt, joy ifodalari)

parts.1: 📌 Adverbs and Adverbial Phrases — Umumiy tushuncha (1/5-qism) 📖 Ravishlar (adverbs) va ravishli iboralar (adverbial phrases) harakatning qanday, qachon, qayerda va qanday chastotada bajarilishini ifodalaydi. Ular fe'l, sifat yoki boshqa ravish ma'nosini to'ldirib, fikrimizni yanada aniq va tushunarli qilish uchun xizmat qiladi. Kundalik muloqotda voqea-hodisalarning tafsilotlarini bayon qilishda ushbu tuzilmalardan juda keng foydalanamiz. Ularsiz nutqimiz sodda va kam ma'lumotli bo'lib qoladi. 💡 Misollar: • He runs fast. — U tez yuguradi. • They live in London. — Ular Londonda yashashadi. 🔔 Eslatma: Ushbu seriyamizning keyingi qismlarida ravish va ravishli iboralarning darak, inkor hamda so'roq gaplardagi to'g'ri o'rni va tuzilish qoidalarini batafsil ko'rib chiqamiz.

grammar_archive.topic: Present Continuous (hozir davom etayotgan harakatlar uchun)

parts.1: 📌 Present Continuous zamoni: Hozir sodir bo'layotgan harakatlar (1/5-qism) 💡 Present Continuous (Hozirgi davomli zamon) aynan ayni damda, gapirayotgan momentimizda sodir bo'layotgan harakatlarni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi. Masalan, siz hozir ushbu postni o'qiyapsiz, men esa uni yozyapman. Bu zamon harakatning muayyan vaqt oralig'ida davom etayotganini va hali yakunlanmaganini ko'rsatadi. O'zbek tiliga ko'pincha fe'lga -yap qo'shimchasini qo'shish orqali tarjima qilinadi. 📖 Misollar: • I am reading an interesting book right now. (Men hozir qiziqarli kitob o'qiyapman.) • Look! It is raining outside. (Qarang! Tashqarida yomg'ir yog'yapti.) • She is speaking on the phone at the moment. (U ayni damda telefonda gaplashyapti.) 📝 Seriyamizning keyingi qismlarida ushbu zamonda darak, inkor va so'roq gap tuzilishini va ularning formulalarini birma-bir o'rganamiz. Kanalimizni kuzatib boring!
parts.2: 🇬🇧 Present Continuous: Darak gap tuzilishi (2/5) 📌 Bugun Present Continuous zamonida darak gaplar tuzish qoidasi bilan tanishamiz. Bu shakl ayni harakat sodir bo'layotgan momentni ifodalash uchun qo'llaniladi. ⚙️ Darak gap formulasi: Subject + am / is / are + Verb-ing • I + am (I'm) • He / She / It + is (He's / She's / It's) • We / You / They + are (We're / You're / They're) 🗣️ Misollar: • I am reading an interesting book right now. (Men hozir qiziqarli kitob o'qiyapman.) • She is cooking dinner in the kitchen. (U oshxonada kechki ovqat pishiryapti.) • They are playing football in the yard. (Ular hovlida futbol o'ynashyapti.) • Look! It is raining outside at the moment. (Qarang! Ayni damda tashqarida yomg'ir yog'yapti.) ❗ Keng tarqalgan xato: Ko'pincha yordamchi fe'l tushirib qoldiriladi. Masalan, "She cooking" deyish noto'g'ri. Har doim am / is / are hamda -ing qo'shimchasini birga ishlating: "She is cooking".
parts.3: 📌 Present Continuous: Inkor gaplar tuzilishi (3/5-qism) 💡 Bugun Present Continuous (hozirgi davomli zamon) iboralarida inkor gaplar (negative sentences) qanday tuzilishini ko'rib chiqamiz. 🔤 Inkor gap formulasi: Subject + am / is / are + not + Verb-ing (Qisqartirilgan shakllari: isn't / aren't. Izoh: am not birga qisqartirilmaydi). 📝 Misollar: 🔹 I am not listening to music right now. (Men hozir musiqa tinglamayapman.) 🔹 She isn't working at the moment. (U ayni damda ishlamayapti.) 🔹 They aren't playing football outside. (Ular tashqarida futbol o'ynashmayapti.) 🔹 We are not watching TV now. (Biz hozir televizor tomosha qilmayapmiz.) ❗ Muhim eslatma: Inkor shaklida ham asosiy fe me'yoriy ravishda -ing qo'shimchasi bilan ishlatiladi. "He isn't work" deyish grammatik xato hisoblanadi, to'g'ri shakli: He isn't working.
parts.4: 📌 Present Continuous: So'roq gaplar (4/5-qism) 💡 Bugun Present Continuous zamonida so'roq gaplar yasash va to'g'ri savol berish qoidalarini ko'rib chiqamiz. ❓ Umumiy savollar (Yes/No questions): Am / Is / Are + ega + fe'l-ing ...? 🔍 Maxsus savollar (Wh- questions): Wh- so'z + am / is / are + ega + fe'l-ing ...? 🗣️ Misollar: • Are you listening to music now? (Siz hozir musiqa eshityapsizmi?) • Is he sleeping in his room? (U xonasida uxlayaptimi?) • What are you cooking for dinner? (Kechki ovqatga nima pishiryapsiz?) • Where are they going right now? (Ular hozir qayerga ketishyapti?) 📝 Eslatma: So'roq gapda am, is, are yordamchi fe'llari har doim egadan oldinga o'tadi. Agar maxsus savol berilayotgan bo'lsa, what, where, why kabi so'zlar gapning eng birinchi o'rniga qo'yiladi.

grammar_archive.topic: Second Conditional (hozir yoki kelajakdagi xayoliy vaziyatlar uchun)

parts.1: 📌 Second Conditional – Xayoliy vaziyatlar (1/5-qism) 💡 Ingliz tilida Second Conditional (Ikkinchi tur shart gaplari) hozirgi yoki kelajakdagi xayoliy va real bo'lmagan vaziyatlarni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi. Bu grammatik tuzilma orqali biz "agar shunday bo'lganida, bunday bo'lardi" deb orzu-havaslarimiz yoki gipotezalarimiz haqida gapiramiz. Real hayotda ushbu vaziyatning sodir bo'lish ehtimoli juda past yoki umuman mavjud emas. Shuning uchun bu qoida nohaqiqiy shartlarni tushuntirishda eng kerakli grammatik vosita hisoblanadi. 📖 Misollar: • If I had a million dollars, I would buy a bigger house. (Agar mening bir million dollarim bo'lganida, katta uy sotib olardim.) • If she spoke French, she would move to Paris. (Agar u fransuzcha gapirganida, Parijga ko'chib o'tardi.) 📝 Keyingi qismlarda Second Conditional mavzusining darak, inkor va so'roq gap tuzilishlarini alohida va batafsil ko'rib chiqamiz. Kanalni kuzatib boring!
parts.2: 🇬🇧 Grammar Time: Second Conditional (2/5) 📌 Second Conditional – hozirgi yoki kelajakdagi nohaqiqiy, xayoliy vaziyatlarni va ularning ehtimoldan yiroq natijasini ifodalaydi. Bugun darak gap tuzilishi haqida gaplashamiz. 📐 Formula: If + Subject + Past Simple, Subject + would + V1 (Agarda "If" qismi gap oxirida kelsa, orasida vergul ishlatilmaydi). 💬 Misollar: • If I had more time, I would learn Spanish. (Agar mening ko'proq vaqtim bo'lganida, ispan tilini o'rgangan bo'lardim.) • If she lived in London, she would speak English fluently. (Agar u Londonda yashaganida, ingliz tilida ravon gapirgan bo'lardi.) • If we won the lottery, we would buy a new house. (Agar biz lotereyada yutganimizda, yangi uy sotib olgan bo'lardik.) • If I were you, I would accept this job offer. (Agar men sizning o'rningizda bo'lganimda, bu ish taklifini qabul qilgan bo'lardim.) 💡 Muhim eslatma: Nohaqiqiy vaziyatlarni ifodalashda I, he, she, it olmoshlari uchun was emas, balki were ishlatish grammatik jihatdan to'g'riroq va rasmiyroq hisoblanadi.

parts.1: 📌 Kelajak rejalar uchun: "Going to" (1/5-qism) 💡 Bugun ingliz tilida kelajakdagi rejalar va niyatlarimiz haqida gapirishni o'rganamiz. Har doim biror ishni qilishni oldindan rejalashtirgan bo'lsak va uni amalga oshirish niyatida bo'lsak, be going to iborasidan foydalanamiz. Bu ibora o'zbek tiliga ko'pincha "-moqchi bo'lmoq" yoki "-moqchiman" deb tarjima qilinadi. Misol uchun, bugun kechqurun kitob o'qimoqchi bo'lsangiz yoki dam olish kunida tog'ga bormoqchi bo'lsangiz, aynan ushbu grammatik iboradan foydalanasiz. 📖 Misollar: 🔹 I am going to buy a new car next week. (Men keyingi hafta yangi mashina sotib olmoqchiman.) 🔹 She is going to learn English this year. (U bu yil ingliz tilini o'rganmoqchi.) 🔔 Keyingi qismlarda going to iborasining darak, inkor va so'roq gaplarda yasalishi va ularning batafsil qoidalarini birma-bir ko'rib chiqamiz. Kanalimizni kuzatib boring!
